steps.content: OwO the director begins to roll around on the ground.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahhh... That doesn't count! Doesn't count, doesn't count, doesn't count!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It should be me who won!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The candy of courage is so powerful, so of course whoever ate it should be the winner!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Plus, I'm the Archdemon! There's no way that I can lose with the double buffs!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Then... maybe... we can make a sequel...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph. But overall, this movie ain't bad. I like it a lot.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... Since you gained courage...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Time to take this off!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No no no no, please don't! That was just in the movie...
OwO reaches out to take off Lynn's helmet, but Lynn covers her head tightly with her arms.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'll... I'll go make movies with you, all right? Sob...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Why are you like this? You seem so unwilling.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You don't like it? I don't want to force you...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sigh... It's a pity if such a great script goes to waste... Don't you think?
OwO turns around, but still peeks at Lynn's reaction from time to time.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Ah, um...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Actually... Actually... I...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I like the script... I like the movie you described...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh! So you do like it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe! I knew it! How can anyone reject OwO's script?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Since you liked it, join me and let's start filming right away!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: R-right now? I-I'm not mentally prepared yet...
OwO tries to pull a terrified Lynn out of the sewers.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, you gave me your word already. Too late to back out now! Come be my signature camerawoman. Let's conquer DisCity's film world together!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Oh... All right...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh right, take this! I have to go now. The dummy clapper will come and brief you on the details.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Huh?
Lynn looks down at what was given to her. It's the candy that she didn't get to eat in the story.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Hehe... That's so nice.
Lynn smiles knowingly, and also steps out of the sewers. The sun shines on her for the first time.
